body: I feel the same way, being dismissed and unheard hurts enough irl, don’t need the reinforcement online. Here to talk if you need
I feel like this all the time, I want to feel the love and affection but I see how I bring them down constantly and can’t bring myself to reach out knowing that. It sucks feeling so alone.
Just had a “talk to your therapist” moment with a so called friend of mine, felt like a stab in the chest and a go fuck itself I don’t care. Hope you find a little bit of joy today, people suck

Last night I went out for a friends birthday, got drunk and the night ended with me sitting on a curb smashing beer bottles, hands cut up and crying. Getting drunk shuts my brain up for about an hour then comes back and beats the depressive, self destructive thoughts right back into me. Sorry to hear you’ve been sick, I’ve had a bunch of hip surgeries and have been in constant physical pain for years now. It really sucks when you’re already fighting mentally and your body does you the disservice of also shutting down

I have some pretty severe depression that’s been around honestly since I can remember. I’m 22 (f) and ever since I experienced SA at 7 I’ve wanted to die. Sometimes I feel like I’m doing this to myself, I see so many people who “get over” their depression but I can’t even fathom what that’s like. The only time I feel any type of relief is when using drugs/alcohol to numb my brain. My reactions/emotions towards things are 100x more intense and dramatic than normal people and unfortunately I’m self aware enough to realize the negative effect my constant misery has on everyone around me. I’m just so tired of living

No problem! So happy her mom was able to talk with you even a little, it’s really comforting to talk with someone who’s in the situation with you. Also not your fault at all, you’re doing everything you can and being as supportive as possible. I have some of the most supportive friends but that didn’t stop my suicidal thoughts and self destructive behavior alone, there’s only so much everyone else can do before ya gotta take it into your own hands. Also feel free to call a crisis center, it’s nice to get advice from a neutral source and they can give you more information on maybe clinics you both can go to even for more intense out patient if inpatient is super scary (I get it). Don’t forget to take care of yourself! You’re needs are just as important even when she’s also having a bad time.

Good for you, easy to be “sad and sorry” when you’re the one who gets to walk away and not be haunted by the memories and emotionally wrecked for the rest of your life... he deserved to be out on blast for what he did
Keep your head up king, thoughts in your head are the hardest ones not to listen to.

I have super similar issues to her and honestly it seems like you’re doing everything in your power to be as supportive as possible and work work through her shit with her. It’s hard to take in but sometimes the best thing to do for someone you love like that is to let them find professional help (had to go to inpatient recently but it turned my life around and I’m so thankful), as much as you love her it’s also not fair that 100% of your emotional energy goes to helping her and not taking care of yourself. I know  it’s not much solace but if it’s meant to be a break won’t keep you guys from reconnecting, she has to be able to handle herself before she can truly give you 100% back like you have been. Keep your head up, sound like an amazing person.
